{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Scores of judges with activist backgrounds in the hard-left now have lifetime tenure in the federal courts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recent events have made it clear that these judges threaten America's dearest institutions and America's way of life.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In some states, activist judges are redefining the institution of marriage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Pledge of Allegiance has already been invalidated by the courts once, and the Supreme Court's ruling has left the Pledge in danger of being struck down again.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Pledge of Allegiance is in danger of being struck down again not because the American people have rejected it, but because a handful of activist judges threaten to overturn commonsense and tradition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Despite the support of the vast majority of Americans for a ban on partial birth abortion, this practice will likely continue by judicial fiat.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The self-proclaimed supremacy of judicial activists is antithetical to the democratic ideals on which the nation was founded.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush has established a record of nominating only judges who have demonstrated respect for the Constitution and the democratic processes of the republic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans in the Senate have strongly supported President Bush's judicial nominees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a call for obstructionist Democrats in the Senate to abandon their filibuster of President Bush's highly qualified judicial nominees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a call for the Republican Party to restore respect for the law to America's courts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
